decisions.reason: A perfect binder close to the core finishing portfolio. Digital print finishing demand is growing, and the line supports spare parts and service revenue, so dropping it in the coming year is unlikely despite possible model succession.
A fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's strategic push toward integrated automation and lifecycle service, making it a core product worth keeping.
An inline/nearline booklet maker matches the focus on digital print finishing and automation and sits at the heart of the established bookletmaking offer.
